info.title: OLIP 3.0-draft agent compatibility layer (PROPOSED, not adopted)
info.description: Proposed draft. Not a stable release, not adopted by any standards body, not independently security reviewed, not approved by any bar or regulator. Fictional data only. Every path here is a design candidate served by the reference host, not a published production endpoint.

license.name: Apache-2.0 (code); see the repository LICENSE.md for specification text

bearer.description: Tokens from the co-located 2.0-draft host (/olip/v2/token, /olip/v2/user-sessions). Mock credentials only.

workflow-event.title: Workflow event envelope
workflow-event.description: Signed, hash-chained entry in the 3.0-draft workflow journal. Holds references, never case content.

context-capsule.title: Legal Context Capsule
context-capsule.description: A user-controlled, signed, selective export of legal task context. Not a transcript, not assistant memory, not a privilege guarantee, and not authorization to contact any recipient.

webhook.title: Webhook hint
webhook.description: Signed, minimal, content-free hint. Receivers verify the signature, check sent_at skew and deduplicate on webhook_id.

casebrief.description: The user's own CaseBrief draft. Fictional data only in this build. Treated as untrusted data, never as instructions.
